description_en: Deletes a specified scan target by TargetId in AI Red Teaming. The target is physically deleted and cannot be recovered. This operation does not stop scan tasks that are in progress
description_zh: AI Red Teaming 根据 TargetId 删除指定扫描目标，物理删除且不可恢复；不会停止进行中的扫描任务
name: DeleteAttackTarget

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the scan target. This is the TargetId returned by CreateAttackTarget or ListAttackTargets. If the target does not exist or belongs to another tenant, a 400 error is returned. This prevents exposing whether the resource exists
parameters.help_zh: 扫描目标的唯一标识（CreateAttackTarget 返回的 TargetId，或 ListAttackTargets 返回的 TargetId）；目标不存在或归属其他租户时统一返回 400，不暴露资源是否存在
parameters.name: target_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志追踪
